# Gautam Talks

> Gautam Talks is Gautam Khosla, a Computer Engineering student at the University of
> Ottawa and MLH hackathon award winner who documents hackathons, startups and
> engineering builds on YouTube. The through-line of the channel is simple:
> start before you feel ready.

## Who

- Name: Gautam Khosla. Online as: Gautam Talks.
- Studying Computer Engineering (Co-op) at the University of Ottawa, Ottawa, Canada.
- Awards: MLH Best Use of Snowflake API (HackConcordia), award winner at ConUHacks X
  (Quebec's largest hackathon), Top 9 at McHacks with Backboard.io.
- Currently building two startups and filming the process.
